attempts.summary: Configured zram-generator on node1 to provide 981 MB of zstd-compressed in-memory swap (exceeds the 512 MB minimum), with swap-priority 100 so it is preferred over any disk-backed swap (none present). The unit is generator-based (dev-zram0.swap / systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service, "static", regenerated by systemd at every boot from /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf), so it activates automatically at boot with no manual enable step. Verified across a full reboot of node1: boot ID changed from d6298ced-a924-4ce7-bbed-0fb8179eda8e to 1c856cb8-f1f8-45eb-bfc9-e215f6fc9369 (uptime reset to 0), and post-reboot swapon/zramctl show the same 981M zstd zram0 swap active with priority 100 automatically, with no other swap devices competing.
